title: Langrisser V: The End of Legend
native_title: ラングリッサーⅤ ～ジ・エンド・オフ・レジェンド～
overview:
The Langrisser legend concludes here.

- High-quality animation by character designer Satoshi Urushihara and animation director Kinji Yoshimoto!
- Full-size visuals used for in-game event scenes!
- A lavish voice cast to adorn the final installment of the series!

Langrisser V: The End of Legend is the strategy RPG that closes the saga of the holy sword, picking up shortly after Langrisser IV. You play as Sigma, an artificial soldier created by the wizard Gizlof, who awakens knowing almost nothing of the world. Guided by Lambda, another of Gizlof's creations, he is hunted by the ambitious lord Rainforce while meeting allies such as Claret, a girl searching for a legendary sorceress, and the mercenary leader Brenda.

Before each battle, hire troops for every commander, then lead them across the battlefield in turn-based combat as the long war between light and darkness reaches its final chapter and the mysteries of the series are laid bare.

ラングリッサー伝説、ここに完結。

●キャラクターデザイン うるし原智志 アニメーション監督 よしもときんじによるハイクオリティアニメーション！
●ゲーム中のイベントシーンにフルサイズビジュアルを採用！
●シリーズ最終作を彩る豪華声優陣！
